scenes.kicker: Already lost money to a scam?
scenes.headline: The fake FBI may call next
scenes.body: They offer to get your money back
scenes.say: Already lost money to a scam? The fake FBI may call next.

scenes.headline: Fake IC3 staff
scenes.body: IC3 is the FBI's Internet Crime Complaint Center.
scenes.say: On July twentieth, the FBI warned that scammers pose as staff of IC3, its Internet Crime Complaint Center, to target people who were already scammed.

scenes.headline: Pay us to get it back
scenes.body: They offer to recover your money, for a payment.
scenes.say: They offer to recover your lost money, and then they ask you to pay.

scenes.headline: Fake sites, cloned voices, deepfakes
scenes.body: Including AI videos of senior FBI leaders.
scenes.say: They use fake IC3 websites, spoofed caller ID, cloned voices, and AI deepfake videos of senior FBI leaders.

scenes.headline: IC3 never asks you to pay
scenes.body: It does not call, email or message you, and has no social media.
scenes.say: The FBI says IC3 never asks for payment to recover money, and it does not contact people by phone, email or social media.

scenes.headline: A fee to recover money is a second scam.
scenes.body: Treat any recovery fee as a red flag.
scenes.say: Analyst note: if someone wants a fee to recover stolen money, treat it as a second scam.

scenes.headline: Do this tonight
items: Never pay to get money back
scenes.say: Tonight: type ic3.gov yourself, skip sponsored search results, and never pay anyone to get your money back.

scenes.headline: The security story behind the headline.
scenes.say: Sources are in the description. Follow Securidge.
